title: A Wave Rose 250 Meters Above a Dam. The Dam Survived

scenes.text: A wave rose 250 meters above a dam. The dam survived.
On October 9, 1963, in Italy, a mountainside slid into the Vajont reservoir.
About 270 million cubic meters of rock hit the water at up to 30 meters per second.
The slide lasted less than a minute.
The surge shot over the 265-meter arch dam and flooded the valley below, killing about 2,000 people.
The dam itself stayed standing, and it still does today. A wave taller than the dam.

description:
In 1963, a landslide in Italy sent a wave 250 meters above the Vajont dam, and the dam survived.
About 270 million cubic meters of rock hit the reservoir in under a minute.
Could you build something that strong?
first_comment: How can a dam survive a wave taller than itself?
